english: out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaks
also: one speaks what is in one’s heart

terms.latin: Ex abundantiā enim cordis ōs loquitur.

terms.comment: The verse without enim, as it is quoted on its own.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, cited by printed page; each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
Vulgate verses checked against the Clementine text at Bible Study Tools and the Latin Library texts (CLTK mirror) (12 November 2026).
